summary: Ticket 3 is triaged as high urgency in the Availability category due to a login outage blocking the entire team [s2.f1]. Ticket 1 is triaged as high urgency in the billing category because a customer was billed twice and the finance books close Friday [s1.f1]. Ticket 2 is triaged as low urgency in the feature-request category as the customer explicitly stated the CSV export request is not urgent [s1.f2].

findings.title: Ticket 3: High urgency - login outage (Availability)
findings.detail: Post-update login 500 errors block the entire team; user requests escalation as critical.

evidence.quote: Since yesterday's update the login page shows error 500 for every attempt. Our whole team is blocked.

findings.title: Ticket 1: Duplicate billing - high urgency
findings.detail: Customer billed twice for invoice 4471; finance books close Friday, making it time-sensitive.

evidence.quote: This is urgent, our finance team closes the books on Friday.

findings.title: Ticket 2: CSV export feature request - low urgency
findings.detail: Customer requests CSV export of dashboard reports; explicitly stated as not urgent.

evidence.quote: Not urgent, just a nice to have.
